newsitem.title: USA: U.S. zinc output down in January-July period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. zinc output down in January-July period.

text.p: U.S. zinc smelter slab production in January through July fell to 137,869 short tons from 143,555 short tons in the same period last year, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics reported.
Output in July rose to 20,482 tons from 19,830 tons in June, and 19,043 tons in June 1995.
The daily average production of 683 tons in July was the highest since February's 694 tons.
Shipments from U.S. plants only totaled 140,393 tons in January through July, down from 144,399 tons in the same period last year. Shipments in July rose to 20,621 tons from 20,375 tons in June.
Inventories at U.S. plants and elsewhere in the U.S. totaled 4,587 tons in July, down from 7,454 tons in July 1995, and 4,772 tons in June 1996.
